full_prompt_en: A square romantic landscape painting looks through a great dark arch formed by old masonry and twisting tree roots into a sunlit stone courtyard. The arch fills the upper and side edges, creating a near-black foreground frame whose rough bark and rock textures are visible around the opening. On the left, a pale classical building extends toward the distance with repeated windows, columns, and ornamented cornices. On the right, a darker structure and thick exposed roots descend toward a flight of steps that leads into the central open space. Beyond the steps, trees, shrubs, and another stone crossing or terrace appear in layered green and ocher tones. A few tiny birds or dark wing shapes punctuate the bright sky visible through the opening. The center of the arch is irregular rather than perfectly round, allowing foliage to break its edges and make the view feel discovered rather than formal. Light comes from beyond the arch, illuminating the distant courtyard and pale left façade while leaving the roots and near interior in strong shadow. Small warm highlights pick out carved details and stair edges. The paint handling is finely blended in the architecture and more textured in bark, stone, and foliage, with an aged oil surface that softens sharp transitions. A narrow path of light guides the eye from the dark lower foreground toward the bright middle distance. No human figure or readable sign is apparent in the selected scene. The overall composition is theatrical and secluded, using a heavy organic frame to reveal a delicate architectural world beyond.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形浪漫主义风景画从旧石砌与扭曲树根形成的巨大暗拱向外望，看到日照石院。拱洞填满上方与侧边，形成近黑前景画框，开口周围可见粗糙树皮与岩石肌理。左侧一栋浅色古典建筑向远处延伸，窗、柱与雕饰檐口重复排列。右侧更暗的建筑和粗厚外露树根向通往中央开放空间的台阶垂下。台阶之外，树、灌木和另一道石质过道或平台在层层绿与赭色中出现。几只小鸟或深色翅形点在开口内明亮天空上。拱心不规则而非完美圆，叶丛打断边缘，让景象像被发现而非刻意正面安排。光从拱外来，照亮远处院落和左侧浅立面，让近处根部与内部保持强阴影。小暖亮点选出雕刻细节与台阶边。建筑处颜料细致融合，树皮、石头和叶丛处更有肌理，陈旧油画表面柔化锐利过渡。一条狭窄光路把视线从深色下前景引向明亮中远处。所选场景看不到清楚人物或可读标牌。整体构图戏剧化而隐蔽，以沉重有机画框揭示后方细腻的建筑世界。
style_prompt_en: The painting uses old-master romantic landscape structure with a deep dark foreground aperture framing a luminous middle distance. Warm stone, olive foliage, and cool shadow sit in carefully layered depth, with precise built edges softened by textured organic forms. A narrow light path pulls the eye inward, while near-black side masses compress the field and make the opening glow. Fine blended passages coexist with rough barklike marks and aged varnish warmth. Backlight clarifies distant planes and leaves close surfaces in strong shade. The overall effect is theatrical, secluded, and richly atmospheric.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画采用古典大师式浪漫风景结构，以深暗前景开口框住发亮中远处。暖石色、橄榄绿叶和冷阴影被谨慎分层，精确人工边缘由有肌理的有机形柔化。狭窄光路把视线向内牵，近黑侧面体量压缩画域，使开口更亮。细致融合的部分与树皮般粗笔痕、旧罩染暖色并存。逆光使远平面清楚，近表面留在深影。整体效果戏剧化、隐蔽且空气层次丰厚。
theme_en: An old stone courtyard seen through a giant arch of twisted tree roots
theme_zh: 从巨大扭曲树根拱洞望向古老石院
name: Jacques Amans
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
